面向教师 For Faculty

《主动学习与合作学习》——提供27个改进教学的简单思路。它为《如何改善学生学习》微型指南中的思路奠定基础。#550m

Active and Cooperative Learning—Provides 27 simple ideas for the improvement of instruction. It lays the foundation for the ideas found in the mini-guide How to Improve Student Learning. #550m

《批判性思维与创造性思维》——通过两者在学习中的根本作用，着重探讨批判性思维与创造性思维的相互关系。#565m

Critical and Creative Thinking—Focuses on the interrelationship between critical and creative thinking through the essential role of both in learning. #565m

《批判性思维能力标准》——为评估学生的批判性思维能力提供框架。#555m

Critical Thinking Competency Standards— Provides a framework for assessing students’ critical thinking abilities. #555m

《批判性思维读写测试》——评估学生将阅读和写作用作获取知识的工具的能力。提供评分量规，并概述细读与言之有物的写作的五个层次。#563m

Critical Thinking Reading and Writing Test—Assesses the ability of students to use reading and writing as tools for acquiring knowledge. Provides grading rubrics and outlines five levels of close reading and substantive writing. #563m

《教育时尚》——从批判性思维的视角分析、评判教育趋势和时尚，介绍其中每一种的核心观念、恰当的教育用途及可能的误用。#583m

Educational Fads— Analyzes and critiques educational trends and fads from a critical thinking perspective, providing the essential idea of each one, its proper educational use, and its likely misuse. #583m

《如何改善学生学习》——基于批判性思维的概念和工具，提供30个改进教学的实用思路。它培养《如何研习与学习》微型指南所倡导的学生学习方式。#560m

How to Improve Student Learning—Provides 30 practical ideas for the improvement of instruction based on critical thinking concepts and tools. It cultivates student learning encouraged in the How to Study and Learn mini-guide. #560m

《思维标准》——探究评价推理的准则；阐明在每一个主题和学科中达到思维标准的重要性。#593m

Intellectual Standards—Explores the criteria for assessing reasoning; illuminates the importance of meeting intellectual standards in every subject and discipline. #593m

《苏格拉底式提问》——着重探讨苏格拉底式对话的运作机制、批判性思维为苏格拉底式对话带来的概念工具，以及提问在培养训练有素的心智方面的重要性。#553m

Socratic Questioning—Focuses on the mechanics of Socratic dialogue, on the conceptual tools that critical thinking brings to Socratic dialogue, and on the importance of questioning in cultivating the disciplined mind. #553m

批判性思维基金会

The Foundation for Critical Thinking

批判性思维基金会致力于培养公正无偏的批判性思维，推动教育与社会的根本变革。这种思维倾向于在智识上保持换位理解、谦逊、坚毅、正直和责任感。只有把批判性思维置于教育的基础地位，才可能形成丰富的智识环境。为什么？因为只有当学生学会深入而实质性地思考所学内容时，才能把所学运用于生活。此外，在一个变化不断加速、复杂性不断加剧、相互依存不断增强的世界中，批判性思维如今已成为经济与社会生存的必需条件。

The Foundation for Critical Thinking seeks to promote essential change in education and society through the cultivation of fair-minded critical thinking, thinking predisposed toward intellectual empathy, humility, perseverance, integrity, and responsibility. A rich intellectual environment is possible only with critical thinking at the foundation of education. Why? Because only when students learn to think through the content they are learning in a deep and substantive way can they apply what they are learning in their lives. Moreover, in a world of accelerating change, intensifying complexity, and increasing interdependence, critical thinking is now a requirement for economic and social survival.

作者简介 About the Authors

琳达·埃尔德博士是一位教育心理学家，曾在大学教授心理学和批判性思维。她担任批判性思维基金会会长和批判性思维中心执行主任。埃尔德博士特别关注思想与情绪、认知与情感之间的关系，并提出了独创的批判性思维发展阶段理论。她与人合著了四本关于批判性思维的书，以及二十本思考者指南。她是一位富有感染力的演讲者，在主持批判性思维研讨班方面拥有丰富经验。

Dr. Linda Elder is an educational psychologist who has taught both psychology and critical thinking at the college level. She is the President of the Foundation for Critical Thinking and the Executive Director of the Center for Critical Thinking. Dr. Elder has a special interest in the relation of thought and emotion, the cognitive and the affective, and has developed an original theory of the stages of critical thinking development. She has coauthored four books on critical thinking, as well as twenty thinkers’ guides. She is a dynamic presenter with extensive experience in leading seminars on critical thinking.

理查德·保罗博士是国际批判性思维运动的主要领军人物。他担任批判性思维中心研究主任、全国批判性思维卓越委员会主席，撰写了200多篇文章和七本关于批判性思维的书。保罗博士举办过数百场批判性思维研讨班，并为美国公共广播电视公司（PBS）制作了一套八集的批判性思维视频节目。《纽约时报》《教育周刊》《高等教育纪事报》《美国教师》《教育领导》《新闻周刊》《美国新闻与世界报道》和《读者文摘》等刊物，都曾探讨他的批判性思维观点。

Dr. Richard Paul is a major leader in the international critical thinking movement. He is Director of Research at the Center for Critical Thinking, and the Chair of the National Council for Excellence in Critical Thinking, author of over 200 articles and seven books on critical thinking. Dr. Paul has given hundreds of workshops on critical thinking and made a series of eight critical thinking video programs for PBS. His views on critical thinking have been canvassed in New York Times, Education Week, The Chronicle of Higher Education, American Teacher, Educational Leadership, Newsweek, U.S. News and World Report, and Reader’s Digest.
